newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso drops 7.8 vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso drops 7.8 vs dollar.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 30 Reuter - Colombia's peso fell 7.8 pesos against the dollar to 1,070.8, its lowest level since March 3, dealers said.
The drop came amid heavy demand for greenbacks from vehicle assemblers.
Dealers reported 281 trades worth a total $125 million, below the daily average of about $180 million. The peso hit and intraday high of 1,062.3 and sank to an intraday low of 1,071.
Dealers said demand was high but there were few dollars on offer.'
